name: What steps do I need to follow to generate structured data for my site?

mainEntity.name: What steps do I need to follow to generate structured data for my site?

acceptedAnswer.text: You need to identify your primary entity (product, article, organization), select the correct Schema.org type, gather required properties like name and URL, then generate valid JSON-LD markup. The syntax must conform to recognized Schema.org schemas; invalid formatting renders the data useless. Critical factors include choosing the most accurate schema type, collecting all required properties, and ensuring your page content matches the markup. Use Google's Structured Data Markup Helper or plugins like RankMath to generate the code. Always test with the Rich Results Test before publishing to avoid syntax errors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Identify your entity, pick the right Schema.org type, gather required properties, generate valid JSON-LD, embed it in your page's <head>, and validate with Google's Rich Results Test.
